title: The Lord's Prayer
lines: He is the Son of God and the Savior of the world.
祂是神的兒子，也是世人的救主。
While Jesus was on Earth, he taught everyone about God's love and performed many miracles like healing people.
耶穌在世上的時候，教導大家關於神的愛，並行了許多神蹟，例如醫治人。
One day a crowd gathered around Jesus, so he went up to a mountain side and sat down.
有一天，群眾聚集在耶穌周圍，所以祂上了一座山，坐了下來。
His disciples gathered around him and he began to teach them about what was right and wrong, the kingdom of heaven, and how to treat other people.
祂的門徒聚集在祂身邊，祂就開始教導他們什麼是對與錯、天國的道理，以及如何對待別人。
He taught them about prayer and said, "When you pray, do not be like those who only pretend to be holy."
祂教導他們關於禱告的事，並說：「你們禱告的時候，不要像那些只會假裝神聖的人。」
"They love to stand and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners."
「他們喜歡站在會堂裡和十字路口上禱告。」
"They want to be seen by other people."
"What I'm about to tell you is true."
「我接下來要告訴你們的是實話。」
「他們已經得到了他們全部的賞賜。」
"When you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father who can't be seen."
「你禱告的時候，要進你的內屋，關上門，向看不見的天父禱告。」
"Your Father will reward you because he sees what you do secretly."
「你的天父會賞賜你，因為祂看見你在暗中所做的事。」
"When you pray, do not keep talking on and on."
「你們禱告的時候，不要喋喋不休。」
"They think they will be heard because they talk a lot."
「他們以為話說得多就會蒙垂聽。」
"Your Father knows what you need even before you ask him."
「因為在你們祈求以先，你們的天父就已經知道你們的需要了。」
He explained, "This is how you should pray."
祂解釋說：「所以，你們要這樣禱告。」
"Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored."
「我們在天上的父，願人都尊祢的名為聖。」
"May what you want to happen be done on Earth as it is done in heaven."
「願祢的旨意行在地上，如同行在天上。」
"Give us today our daily bread and forgive us our sins, just as we also have forgiven those who sin against us."
「今日賜給我們日用的飲食，赦免我們的罪，如同我們也饒恕了得罪我們的人。」
"Keep us from sinning when we are tempted."
「當我們受試探時，保守我們免於犯罪。」
